quickref.status: Default since BBG 2.1 (Jul 15, 2013); seen in 2026 playtests (Jul 30, Aug 9, Oct 2026); returns as Botch's Super in BB Heroes (2024)
quickref.look: A translucent lime jelly-starfish blob (about #B0FF23) with about 5 drooping points; it looks bell-shaped from the side. It is 0.6-0.8 Botch-heads and floats at his shoulder or low in front. HUD icon: a plain lime five-armed splat (the 'white dome' is a separate second-slot icon).
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Spins and rises overhead, then rains long tapering lime needles that turn yellow at the tips. The spread widens with height. Lasts 4 s; no melee or weapon switching meanwhile.
quickref.impact_end_result: Damage only, and it hurts players under roofs. Yellow V-splashes on the floor; killed enemies fly apart. At the end it sinks and peters out in a green flash. It self-destructs if Botch dies or the cloud touches a surface.

quickref.status: 100,000 Joules; on a 2.1 screen; changed in 2.6; in 2026 playtests. HUD clip shows 2 (2013-2014, Jul 2026) but 3 in one c.2013-14 HUD and on Oct 16, 2026 (cause unverified)
quickref.look: A large translucent lime skeletal hand of faceted crystal bone segments (about #A5FD23), about 1 Botch-head, floating beside his paw. HUD icon: a lime skeletal hand.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Lobs a 'gleaming blob' on a slight arc at 1,250 u/s, about one per second. Yellow-green motes and green rays appear near targets; the blob itself has not been clearly seen.
quickref.impact_end_result: No direct-hit damage. Bursts into a low rolling carpet of olive-green puffballs (about #477828) that poisons for 12/s over 6 s and stacks; Botch can poison himself. A skull icon appears over victims.

quickref.status: 50 Gas, Level 10; added in 2.17 (Mar 8, 2015); not seen in 2026
quickref.look: A pale-green lumpy cabbage/onion bulb with a stem below and a dark cap on top, about 0.3 Botch-heads, in a column of green glow. HUD icon: a round green cabbage-like ball (low resolution).
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A thrown ball at 600 u/s that ricochets wildly off surfaces, projectiles and players, leaving a green gas trail. One per clip.
quickref.impact_end_result: A tall glowing lime gas column or a broad yellow-green haze that poisons at 18/s for 3 s. It stacks the more victims move through it.

quickref.status: 60 Gas; added in 2.3 (Sep 27, 2013); changed in 2.6 (duration 5 vs 10 s conflict); not seen in 2026
quickref.look: A palm flame with a white-hot core, lime tongues and teal sparks, about 0.5 Botch-heads. It is the 'green flame' in DefaultBotch2 and 7 skin shots. HUD icon: a lime flame with a white centre.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: His palm thrusts forward and the flame becomes a broad, medium-range, pale yellow-lime flamethrower jet that passes through enemies. 2.3 concept art (BBG-branded 'Update 2.3 Botch Weapon Concept Art') shows a long wavy lime stream.
quickref.impact_end_result: Continuous damage (65 DPS listed) to everyone in the cone. No status effect; Specials are blocked while firing.

quickref.status: 60 Gas; added in 2.7 (Jan 23, 2014); HUDs show a 50 clip vs the wiki's 60; not seen in 2026
quickref.look: Two orbs, one hovering beside each paw (lime swirl core in a faceted yellow-white halo), about 0.25 Botch-heads each; they read bright yellow in play. HUD icon: a solid lime disc. They never circle him.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A continuous rapid laser (0.05 s, 3 damage per shot) until the clip is empty. A thin pale-yellow line is visible only at low resolution.
quickref.impact_end_result: The target glows in a lime halo with white flashes. Hit damage only, then a long 5-6 s reload.

quickref.status: 60 Gas; added in 2.7; 2.17 damage glitch fixed in 2.19 (Apr 26, 2015); 4-round clip on HUD (2017); not seen in 2026
quickref.look: A glowing lime sea-mine ball with short pyramid spikes (about #ACF83F), about 0.25 Botch-heads, floating above his shoulder. HUD icon: a lime spiked ball.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: One trigger fires bombs in all 4 directions around Botch. The bombs have not been clearly seen in flight.
quickref.impact_end_result: Each explodes on contact with an enemy or solid object (25-35 splash); no status. No blast has been seen: the orange fireball in q8ExD3R4A7w is the enemy's own muzzle blast.

quickref.status: 60 Gas; added in 2.27 (May 29, 2017); missing from the wiki class page but in Category:Assassin; HUD clip 2 (2017), 4 (2018), 3 (2021, 2024); not seen in 2026
quickref.look: A three-bladed fidget spinner of dark translucent bottle-green (about #1F4C21) with lime rims and a ringed hub, about 1 Botch-head across. HUD icon: a black radiation trefoil with a lime hub.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Spinners fly straight at 1,100 u/s and skim low; 1.5 s rate of fire.
quickref.impact_end_result: An explosion (25-50) plus weak stacking poison (4 per second over 5 s). Seen as purple skull-faced puffs in 2018 but green haze and a green skull icon in 2021, so the colour is unresolved.

quickref.status: Default since 2.1; a pink second-slot icon in the Oct 16, 2026 HUD is probably this weapon
quickref.look: Idle: a small pink-red honeycomb orb (about #E25572), about 0.3 Botch-heads, at his side. His only magenta weapon. HUD and store icon: a pink hex ball.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Deployed in place. It balloons into a huge translucent magenta-violet sphere of faceted hex plates (about #B557D5) lasting 15 s.
quickref.impact_end_result: No damage of its own. Everyone inside, allies included, takes 50% more damage. No overhead icon and no slow.

quickref.status: 100 Gas in the 2.1 store (60 Gas per the wiki); in 2.1 after a pre-release poison change; changed in 2.6; seen in 2024 (build 2.53.6); not seen in 2026
quickref.look: Two lime soccer-ball-lattice spheres, about 0.25 Botch-heads each, drifting around him and trailing yellow-green dots. HUD and store icon: a lime lattice ball.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: On activation the spheres orbit him violently for 5 s at very short range; his primary stays usable.
quickref.impact_end_result: Touch poisons for 24 DPS over the duration. Pale yellow-green skull-faced blobs seen in a 2024 Fear Orbit + Hazard Toy loadout (either weapon could have caused them).

quickref.status: 120,000 Joules; added in 2.3 (Sep 27, 2013); minimum damage raised in 2.6 (infobox 450 vs the 2.6 note's 400); not seen in 2026
quickref.look: Charge: a white-cored lime ball held at his chest, lighting him green, about 0.4 Botch-heads. Its HUD icon is probably the small white-domed second-slot icon (inference).
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A 3 s charge, then a lob straight up through roofs. It falls back within a 10 s round trip as a vertical comet: yellow head at the bottom, white middle, pale cyan tail. It does not home.
quickref.impact_end_result: A big translucent green sphere blast with a white core and a chain of rising green ellipses. It hits the first thing it meets, can hurt Botch, and projectiles can detonate it.

quickref.status: 60 Gas; added in 2.7 (Jan 23, 2014); seen in a 2021 loadout; not seen in 2026
quickref.look: No held prop. HUD icon: a lime ring with radiating inner spikes (sunburst or iris).
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A ground eruption: a 'huge column of green energy' springs up near Botch. A green-white flare is seen at use (attribution is inference).
quickref.impact_end_result: Two explosive hits (15-30 each) in a moderate area. The column stops at Botch's feet, so a player under him is safe. No image of the column has been found.

quickref.status: 150,000 Joules; added in 2.7; HUD 2/2 and disc in flight in the Sep 20, 2026 playtest
quickref.look: A glowing lime frisbee disc with a bright centre and segmented ring (about #B3FD0C), about 0.5 Botch-heads, held tilted. HUD icon: a disc with a dashed ring.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A fast straight throw at 650 u/s, 2 per clip; seen in flight as a flat lime ellipse streak.
quickref.impact_end_result: Explodes on any surface (40-50) as a translucent faceted lime half-dome about bear-sized, sometimes paler or with a cyan inner shell; enemies fly apart. Botch can kill himself with it.

quickref.status: Default since 2.1 (on a 2.1 matchmaking screen); equipment bonuses cut in 2.6; not seen in 2026
quickref.look: An oversized translucent lime crystal fist bristling with spikes (about #ADFE24), 1.0-1.2 Botch-heads, floating over his paw. Store icon: a lime spiked fist.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A punch; the giant crystal fist thrusts forward into the frame.

quickref.status: 45,000 Joules; on a 2.1 matchmaking screen; changed in 2.6; seen in the Sep 20, 2026 playtest menu
quickref.look: A mottled green sphere with bright lime pyramid spikes (about #4ED611), about 0.9 Botch-heads, floating off his paw with no chain. Store icon: a lime spiked ball.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A swing; the huge spiked ball sweeps through the foreground.
quickref.impact_end_result: 40 melee damage and a +30% special-speed modifier. No status.

quickref.status: 20 Gas, Level 5; added in 2.21 (Jul 3, 2015); not seen in 2026
quickref.look: A physical nunchuck stick: black hex-mesh grip with red spiral stripes (about #AC192A), a silver spiked ball cap and a carved green fanged end, about 0.8 Botch-heads. The store icon shows the same single stick. Only one stick has been seen clearly.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A whirling nunchuck swing; a black-red stick with green ends was seen crossing an enemy (low resolution, 2018).
quickref.impact_end_result: 40 melee damage, +5% speed. No status. The chain or 'tongue' has not been seen.

quickref.status: BB Heroes basic attack only; not in BBR or BBG; attack damage +15% in BBH 1.0.12 (Oct 3, 2024)
quickref.look: Unknown: no image found (not on the wiki or in the BBH App Store screenshots).
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Per official text, a boomerang that flies out and returns.
quickref.impact_end_result: Can hit twice ('potentially dealing double damage'). No status stated.
